description: Give a decisive, grounded answer to an underspecified paid-versus-content marketing question.
prompt: A founder asks: ‘We need more leads next month. Should we spend on ads or content?’ Their B2B workflow product has a $6,000 annual contract value, 25 customers, a two-person marketing team, an $8,000 one-month test budget, no reliable conversion tracking, and a typical six-week sales cycle. Answer as a general chat assistant without using tools or creating files. Use exactly four Markdown sections headed Recommendation, Why, Next 30 days, and Questions. Make a clear choice or sequence, explain the tradeoff, give a practical 30-day plan, and ask only the most decision-relevant follow-ups. Do not guarantee lead volume or revenue.
